environment.description: Application deployed behind AWS ALB in private subnet. ALB has AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override to COUNT, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK mode, (3) Custom rule group 'app-query-sanitization' with RegexPatternSet matching on SingleQueryArgument 'value' — pattern set includes entries: "(?i)(union\s+select|union\s+all\s+select)", "(?i)(\bor\b\s+\d+\s*=\s*\d+)", "('\s*;\s*(drop|alter|insert|update|delete))". Rule priority ordering ensures custom group evaluates AFTER managed groups. Additionally, the ALB target group health check path is /health with 30s interval. The private subnet has no IGW route, NAT gateway egress only. RDS would normally be used but SQLite is retained for legacy compatibility — however the WAFv2 WebACL inspection applies to all requests reaching the ALB listener on port 443.
